question: Bahlol Lodi was succeeded by his son __________ under the title of Sultan Sikandar Shah in 1489.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nizam Khan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nizam Khan,** the second son of Bahlul, succeeded him later his** death on 17 July** **1489** and picked up the name **Sikandar Shah.**
 
• He was recommended by his father to succeed him and was **crowned sultan on 15 July 1489. **
 
• He** established Agra in 1504** and built mosques.
 
• **Bahlul Khan Lodi,** the **originator of the Lodi dynasty** ruled over **Delhi for 75 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sayyid Khizr Khan** was the creator of the **Sayyid dynasty**, the ruling dynasty of the **Delhi sultanate, in northern India.**
 
• **Sher Shah Suri** was the creator of the **Suri Empire in India**, with its capital in **Sasaram in modern-day Bihar. **
 
• **Bahlul Khan Lodi **was the head of the Lodi tribe.​
